closing.summary: Big strengths are fibre, vitamin K, and protein, but the biggest weaknesses are low calcium, low fat quality, and taste and texture can limit compliance. It is good for immune support, digestion, and low-calorie volume because vitamin C and vitamin A gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, fibre supports digestion and steadier meals, and it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure.
